connector.name: Tollmint
connector.registryDescription: Per-call data for agents: graded behavioural science, dark-pattern detection, web fetch, geocode.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.tollmint.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.tollmint, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <api key> for paid tools. Omit it to browse: tollmint_catalog and tollmint_quote are free, and every paid tool returns its price rather than failing when called without one.
